characters.name: Persephone
characters.role: Goddess of Spring and the mortal realm

outfit.notes: Her college look when she arrives in Olympus.

abilities.name: Plant growth
abilities.description: Grows and shapes plants and flowers

abilities.name: Red eyes
abilities.description: Eyes turn red when she is drunk or furious

relationships.notes: Demeter is fiercely protective of her.
First meets Hades at his party.
Apollo begins courting her against her wishes.
A brief secret fling she regrets.
Hecate runs the Underworld Corp with him.
Falls for her at his party.
Shared a bitter history before Hades.

characters.name: Apollo
characters.role: God of the Sun and Music

relationships.notes: Pressures her into a relationship she does not want.

abilities.name: Control the seasons
abilities.description: Turns the world cold and barren when grieving

characters.name: Hecate
characters.role: Witch; Hades' second-in-command at Underworld Corp

relationships.notes: Runs the Underworld Corp with him.
Takes Persephone under her wing at the internship.
Gives her a makeover; becomes a close friend.

characters.name: Thanatos
characters.role: God of Death; Underworld Corp employee

events.title: Persephone arrives in Olympus
events.summary: Persephone leaves the mortal realm to study at university in Olympus and becomes Artemis' roommate.

events.title: Persephone and Hades meet at the party
events.summary: At Hades' party, Persephone and Hades meet for the first time and are immediately drawn to each other.

events.title: Drunk Persephone turns red-eyed
events.summary: Persephone gets drunk at the party, her eyes turn red, and Hades drives her home.

events.title: Minthe and Hades' toxic relationship shown
events.summary: Minthe is revealed as Hades' on-and-off girlfriend, manipulative and demeaning.

events.title: Persephone interns at Underworld Corp
events.summary: Hecate takes Persephone on as an intern at Underworld Corp; Hades is her boss.

events.title: Demeter forbids the Underworld
events.summary: Demeter arrives in Olympus, furious, and forbids Persephone from setting foot in the Underworld.

events.title: Eros befriends Persephone
events.summary: Eros gives Persephone a makeover and becomes her close friend and confidant.

events.title: Persephone's secret fling with Ares
events.summary: Persephone has a brief secret fling with Ares, which she later regrets.

events.title: Hades saves Persephone at the pool party
events.summary: At a pool party, drunk Persephone nearly drowns; Hades dives in and saves her.

events.title: Apollo begins pursuing Persephone
events.summary: Apollo starts pressuring Persephone into a relationship, threatening and gaslighting her.

events.title: Hades and Persephone's first kiss
events.summary: Hades and Persephone share their first kiss.

events.title: Hades breaks up with Minthe
events.summary: Hades finally ends his toxic relationship with Minthe.

events.title: Minthe and Thanatos' history revealed
events.summary: Minthe and Thanatos reveal their bitter shared history, explaining her resentment.

events.title: Hades glimpses Persephone's act of wrath
events.summary: Hades sees a vision of Persephone's buried past — an 'act of wrath' in which her power killed mortals.

events.title: Apollo assaults Persephone
events.summary: Apollo forces himself on Persephone in her apartment; she dissociates through it.

events.title: Persephone flees to the mortal realm
events.summary: In the aftermath of the assault, Persephone flees Olympus and returns home to Demeter.

events.title: Persephone moves into the Underworld
events.summary: Persephone returns and moves into the Underworld; Hades vows to protect her from Apollo.

events.title: Hades accepts the act of wrath
events.summary: Hades learns the full truth of Persephone's act of wrath and accepts her completely.

locations.name: Olympus
locations.notes: Realm of the gods; Persephone studies at university here.

locations.name: The Underworld
locations.notes: Hades' realm, where the dead are pensioned. Persephone moves here at episode 47.

locations.name: Underworld Corp
locations.notes: Hades' office tower; Persephone interns here, Hecate runs it with him.

locations.name: Persephone's apartment
locations.notes: Shared with Artemis in Olympus. Site of the assault at episode 42.

locations.name: Demeter's estate
locations.notes: Demeter's home in the mortal realm; Persephone flees here at episode 44.

locations.name: Eros' pool house
locations.notes: Party venue where Persephone nearly drowns and Hades saves her.
